title: LAMP Fellowship 2027–28 (Legislative Assistants to MPs)
summary: Eleven-month fellowship working with a Member of Parliament on legislative research, with training by PRS Legislative Research.
eligibility: Indian citizens aged 25 or under with a bachelor's degree in any discipline completed before the fellowship starts. Open to arts, commerce, science, law and engineering graduates.

prize.description: ₹23,000 per month for the duration of the fellowship.

notes: The form typically opens in December, with an online test in January and results by end-March. The last cycle closed 21 December 2025.
